subject: 97-99 Revere Beach Parkway Redevelopment
overview: The commission reviewed a Notice of Intent for the redevelopment of the former KISS 108 radio station site into a multi-family residential building with waterfront public access. The hearing was continued to allow the applicant time to address concerns regarding stormwater management, groundwater data, and invasive species removal.

items.title: Notice of Intent: 97-99 Revere Beach Parkway
items.summary: TPC Land Acquisition Company LLC proposed a 352,400-square-foot multi-family building featuring ground-floor retail and public walkways along the Malden River. Commissioners requested additional technical data regarding seasonal high groundwater levels, the stability of the proposed stormwater level spreader, and more robust invasive species management protocols. The hearing was continued to July 23, 2025, pending the issuance of a DEP file number and submission of revised planting and mitigation plans.

items.title: Commission Business and General Updates
items.summary: Members discussed recruitment challenges for the commission, updates on the 54 South Street planting plan, and the successful completion of an Eagle Scout bridge project.
